summary: Notice of guardianship/conservatorship proceeding and post-appointment events.
applies: Title 18-C (Maine Uniform Probate Code), effective 2019-09-01 — see transition_18a.

governing.title: Notice of hearing
governing.why: Notice of hearing in a guardianship/conservatorship proceeding.

governing.title: Special limitations on guardian's power
governing.why: Special limitations on a guardian's power (dwelling change, contact).

considerations.title: Special limitations on guardian's power
considerations.note: Moving the protected person's dwelling triggers notice/limits on guardian power.

considerations.title: Special limitations on guardian's power
considerations.note: Restricting contact with others is a specially limited guardian power requiring notice.

considerations.title: Guardian's plan
considerations.note: A revised guardian's plan must be filed/approved.

considerations.title: Conservator's report and accounting; monitoring
considerations.note: Conservator's report and accounting is filed and noticed.

transition_18a: 18-C Article 5 (Maine Uniform Guardianship, Conservatorship and Protective Proceedings Act) governs proceedings pending on or commenced after 2019-09-01. Orders entered under former Title 18-A may rest on different standards; the modern least-restrictive / supported-decision-making framework applies going forward. See _index/18a-key-diffs.json.
disclaimer: Statutes for consideration only — NOT legal advice and not a substitute for a Maine attorney. Citations point to issues a filler should weigh, not to a conclusion. Verify against current law; which code applies can turn on the date of death (see transition_18a).
